english: Which brings us to our second point, His ancestral lineage.  This land in which Naropa took His holy birth was split up into different levels of society, with a great many different castes such as the royalty; the nobility; the priests; the common people; and the outcastes--people like the butchers. Among all these different groups, there was one mighty and upright clan which stood out as supreme--a people like the sal tree, with its wood of natural white incense.  This was the Shakya clan, and Naropa was born into a royal lineage within this very people.
